info.name: FDIC Bank Data API (Beta) Demographics Historical API
Get Historical Aggregate Data by Year

params.name: filters
params.description:
The filter criteria that refines the records included in the calculated result. All values must be entered in UPPERCASE.
example: >-
STNAME:"Alabama" AND YEAR:2005
Examples:
* Filter by Community Banks (CB) vs. Savings Institutions (SI)  
`CB_SI:CB`  
* Filter by State name  
`STNAME:"Virginia"`    
* Filter all but a specified value  
`!(STNAME:"Virginia")`  
* Filter for any one of multiple State names  
`STNAME:("West Virginia","Delaware")`    
* Filter data by the year range  
`YEAR:["2015" TO "2017"]`

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma delimited list of fields with aggregated annual financial data to return. All values must be entered in UPPERCASE.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Field name by which to sort returned data. All values must be entered in UPPERCASE.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Indicator if ascending (ASC) or descending (DESC). All values must be entered in UPPERCASE.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of records to return. Default is 10 and maximum is 10,000.

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset of page to return.

params.name: agg_by
params.description: The field by which data will be aggregated. All values must be entered in UPPERCASE.

params.name: agg_term_fields
params.description: The field(s) for which aggregations will be counted for each unique term. All values must be entered in UPPERCASE.

params.name: agg_sum_fields
params.description: The field(s) for which aggregations will be summed or aggregated. All values must be entered in UPPERCASE.

params.name: agg_limit
params.description: The limit on how many aggregated results will be displayed.

params.name: max_value
params.description: The field by which the max value is desired.

params.name: max_value_by
params.description: The field that will be used to determine unique records, similar to a primary key (i.e. CERT). All values must be entered in UPPERCASE.

params.name: format
params.description: The format of the data to return.

params.name: download
params.description: Whether the data should be downloaded as a file.

params.name: filename
params.description: The filename to use when downloading data.

items.docs: Returns aggregate financial and structure data, subtotaled by year, regarding finanical institutions.
